description: This file defines the FeatureDefinition interface, which represents a list of unique, fully qualified Identifier objects within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.things package. It provides static methods for creating FeatureDefinitions from identifiers, JSON strings, or JSON arrays, and instance methods for accessing the first identifier, size, and streaming the identifiers. It emphasizes immutability and JSON serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: FeatureDefinition
classes.description: An immutable interface representing a list of unique, fully qualified DefinitionIdentifiers, with methods for creation from identifiers and JSON, and accessing the identifiers.

methods.name: fromIdentifier
methods.description: Creates an immutable FeatureDefinition from a primary identifier and optional additional identifiers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an immutable FeatureDefinition from a JSON string representing a JsonArray.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an immutable FeatureDefinition from a JsonArray object.

methods.name: getFirstIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves the first (and guaranteed to exist) DefinitionIdentifier.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of identifiers contained in the FeatureDefinition.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a Stream of the contained DefinitionIdentifiers.
